remarks: Welcome Home! This beautiful and well-maintained 3-bedroom 2 bath colonial offers modern comfort and timeless charm. Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street, this charming home features a well-maintained front lawn and a stone walkway leading to the entrance, adding to its warm, classic character. Inside, you'll find a sun-drenched layout ideal for everyday living. The kitchen is updated with modern appliances and flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas. Upstairs, the primary bedroom includes a full bath, and two additional bedrooms offer ample closet space and shared access to a second full bath. Enjoy outdoor living in the relaxing backyard or take advantage of nearby parks, schools, shopping, and public transportation. Move-in-ready condition! Schedule your appointment today and make this inviting residence your new home!
